scope: RoadRunner visual-build export validation pipeline (FBX / Datasmith / tiled)

risks.title: FBX existence mistaken for CARLA readiness
risks.description: An export directory containing .fbx files is assumed importable by CARLA without XODR authority, material mapping, or semantic group validation.
risks.impact: CARLA import fails silently or loads corrupted/incomplete geometry, producing invalid perception results.
risks.mitigation: validate_fbx_not_sufficient_for_carla() emits a hard diagnostic when .fbx is present but no .xodr authority exists. The build_carla_import_manifest tool explicitly reports carla_ready=false.
risks.residual_risk: Operator may ignore the diagnostic if running outside the gate matrix.

risks.title: Scale relative error exceeds 1e-4 threshold
risks.description: Mesh geometry scaled incorrectly relative to XODR source, e.g. centimetres treated as metres or vice versa.
risks.impact: All downstream distance/velocity metrics are systematically biased; CARLA spawn positions drift.
risks.mitigation: validate_scale_error() rejects exports with scale_error_relative > SCALE_RELATIVE_TOLERANCE (1e-4). Units field validated against KNOWN_UNITS.
risks.residual_risk: Tolerance may be too tight for some third-party FBX exporters; manual override needed.

risks.title: Systematic heading error exceeds 0.1 degrees
risks.description: Mesh rotated relative to XODR, e.g. RoadRunner coordinate convention mismatch (Y-up vs Z-up).
risks.impact: Road centre-line and lane edges misaligned; junction connectivity broken in CARLA.
risks.mitigation: validate_heading_error() enforces HEADING_ERROR_DEGREES_TOLERANCE (0.1 deg). detect_y_inversion() flags Y-axis flips.
risks.residual_risk: Small heading errors near threshold may pass but compound over large maps.

risks.title: Y-axis inversion between mesh and XODR
risks.description: All Y-coordinates negated due to Unreal Engine (Y-forward) vs OpenDRIVE (Y-left) convention mismatch.
risks.impact: Entire map mirrored; roads appear on wrong side; spawn points inverted.
risks.mitigation: detect_y_inversion() checks for systematic sign flip across control points. validate_y_inversion() adds a hard error to alignment result.
risks.residual_risk: Detection requires >= 2 control points; single-point exports cannot be checked.

risks.title: Road-centre mesh/XODR residual exceeds 0.10 m
risks.description: Visual mesh road surface deviates from XODR reference line beyond tolerance.
risks.impact: Perception models trained on misaligned mesh produce incorrect lane detections.
risks.mitigation: validate_road_centre_residual() enforces ROAD_CENTRE_RESIDUAL_TOLERANCE_M (0.10 m) with target 0.05 m. Informational warning at target threshold.
risks.residual_risk: Curved road segments may exceed tolerance locally while passing globally.

risks.title: Lane-edge residual exceeds 0.15 m
risks.description: Lane boundary in mesh does not match XODR lane geometry within tolerance.
risks.impact: Lane-level perception metrics biased; lane-change scenarios invalid.
risks.mitigation: validate_lane_edge_residual() enforces LANE_EDGE_RESIDUAL_TOLERANCE_M (0.15 m).
risks.residual_risk: Complex junction lane geometry may locally exceed tolerance.

risks.title: Grounded sign/light residual exceeds 0.30 m
risks.description: Traffic signs or lights placed at incorrect positions relative to XODR references.
risks.impact: Sign detection perception metrics invalid; regulatory element testing compromised.
risks.mitigation: validate_junction_residual() enforces GROUNDED_SIGN_LIGHT_RESIDUAL_TOLERANCE_M (0.30 m).
risks.residual_risk: Signs placed on sidewalks may legitimately differ from XODR reference points.

risks.title: Missing required semantic class (Road/RoadLines/Sidewalk/Terrain)
risks.description: Export lacks one or more of the four mandatory CARLA semantic classes.
risks.impact: CARLA semantic segmentation produces unlabeled regions; perception training data incomplete.
risks.mitigation: validate_required_classes() and validate_semantic_groups() check for all four classes. validate_semantic_coverage() warns on zero-object classes.
risks.residual_risk: Class name casing differences (e.g. 'road' vs 'Road') handled via case-insensitive comparison but exotic variants may slip through.

risks.title: Duplicate road surface material
risks.description: Multiple materials assigned is_road_surface=True, causing ambiguous road surface classification.
risks.impact: CARLA applies wrong material to road mesh; visual appearance inconsistent.
risks.mitigation: validate_no_duplicate_road_surface() in both export_inventory and semantic_manifest detects duplicates via Counter.
risks.residual_risk: Intentional multi-material road (e.g. asphalt + cobblestone transition) requires manual override.

risks.title: Road semantic group has collision disabled
risks.description: collision_enabled=False set for the Road class, allowing vehicles to pass through road geometry.
risks.impact: CARLA physics simulation broken; vehicles fall through or clip road mesh.
risks.mitigation: validate_collision_intent() and validate_road_collision_enabled() enforce Road collision_enabled=True.
risks.residual_risk: None for standard use; override only valid for visual-only debug builds.

risks.title: Multiple XODR authority files in package
risks.description: Package manifest declares more than one XODR authority, causing ambiguity about which is canonical.
risks.impact: Pipeline may load wrong XODR; map topology inconsistent.
risks.mitigation: validate_one_xodr_authority() enforces exactly one XodrAuthorityEntry. validate_xodr_authority() checks expected_files for .xodr count.
risks.residual_risk: Multi-map packages (e.g. scenario variants) require separate manifests.

risks.title: Duplicate tile names or grid positions
risks.description: Tiled export contains two tiles with same name or same grid coordinates.
risks.impact: Tile loader overwrites one tile; map coverage has gaps or duplicates.
risks.mitigation: validate_tile_names_unique() and validate_tile_grid_positions() detect duplicates. validate_tile_grid() in export_inventory checks both.
risks.residual_risk: None significant.

risks.title: Unexplained tile-origin offset
risks.description: Tile origins have offsets not consistent with grid spacing, indicating export or tiling error.
risks.impact: Tiles do not align when assembled; seams visible in CARLA.
risks.mitigation: validate_tile_origins_consistent() checks finite origins and computes spacing consistency. validate_tile_origin_offsets() in alignment checks against TRANSLATION_RESIDUAL_TOLERANCE_M.
risks.residual_risk: Intentional non-uniform grids require metadata flag.

risks.title: SHA-256 hash mismatch on exported file
risks.description: File on disk does not match the hash recorded in the inventory, indicating corruption or tampering.
risks.impact: Downstream validation uses stale/corrupted data; reproducibility broken.
risks.mitigation: validate_file_hashes() recomputes SHA-256 for every file in expected_files and compares. Gate artifact_hashes enforces match.
risks.residual_risk: Race condition if files modified during validation; mitigate with directory snapshot.

risks.title: Non-finite coordinates in bounding box or origin
risks.description: NaN or Inf values in bounding box, origin, or tile coordinates due to parser failure.
risks.impact: Downstream arithmetic produces NaN; rendering/physics breaks silently.
risks.mitigation: _finite() helper rejects NaN/Inf at construction time for all coordinate-bearing dataclasses.
risks.residual_risk: Parser-level NaN may propagate before inventory construction.

risks.title: Placeholder values in contract fields
risks.description: Fields contain placeholder strings like 'todo', 'tbd', 'unknown' instead of real values.
risks.impact: Gate validation passes with dummy data; real validation never runs.
risks.mitigation: _reject_placeholder() called in all validate_identifier() and validate_sha256() paths. Schema $defs/placeholder enum blocks known placeholders.
risks.residual_risk: Novel placeholder strings not in the blocklist may slip through.

risks.title: Mesh manifest object counts inconsistent with export inventory
risks.description: MeshManifest.total_vertices differs from ExportInventory.mesh_stats.total_vertices for same export.
risks.impact: Contradictory metadata; which source is correct becomes ambiguous.
risks.mitigation: validate_mesh_object_counts() checks sum-of-objects vs declared totals. Cross-module consistency requires same source data.
risks.residual_risk: Two independently constructed manifests may drift; recommend single source of truth.

risks.title: Package JSON tile_count mismatches declared tiles
risks.description: package_json.tile_count != len(tiles) in PackageManifest.
risks.impact: Partial export not detected; tiles missing from CARLA.
risks.mitigation: validate_package_json() checks tile_count consistency. validate_package_json_file() verifies JSON structure.
risks.residual_risk: package.json may be generated by external tool with different tile enumeration.

risks.title: Control-point fit RMS exceeds road-centre tolerance
risks.description: RMS of horizontal errors across control points > 0.10 m, indicating poor overall alignment.
risks.impact: Systematic spatial drift across the map; perception metrics biased.
risks.mitigation: validate_control_point_fit() computes RMS and compares against ROAD_CENTRE_RESIDUAL_TOLERANCE_M.
risks.residual_risk: Sparse control points may not capture local distortions.

risks.title: Road-centre residual between target and tolerance
risks.description: Residual between 0.05 m (target) and 0.10 m (tolerance) produces informational warning but not failure.
risks.impact: Marginal exports pass gate but may produce degraded perception results.
risks.mitigation: validate_road_centre_residual() emits two messages: hard error at tolerance, informational at target.
risks.residual_risk: Informational messages may be overlooked in automated pipelines.

summary.notes: All critical risks have mitigation in code. Residual high risks require operational discipline (operator must not ignore gate failures).
